title: Query ranges: filter vs range on an outer join, and a custom range function
instruction: Ground with get_knowledge(topic="query-object-model"). In the sandbox model write a class that builds a Query at run time and shows the distinction that silently changes results: a RANGE restricts a data source before the join, while a QueryFilter (query.addQueryFilter(qbds, fieldStr(...))) restricts the joined result - on an OUTER join a range turns it into an inner join and drops the unmatched parents. Use SysQuery:: to build every value (SysQuery::value, ::valueNot, ::range, ::valueEmptyString) rather than concatenating strings. Then add a user-callable range function: [ExtensionOf(classStr(SysQueryRangeUtil))] public static class <Prefix>Ranges_Extension with a [QueryRangeFunction()] public static str method returning a SysQuery:: value. Build with zero errors and zero BP errors.
